title: Combat rogue: Kick on a casting mob within 3 s of the cast start

rules.desc: The rogue interrupts (Kick, or Kidney Shot as the node's alternative) an interruptible cast of the mob within 3 s of its cast start, at least 60 percent of the time (one trigger per mob per 10 s: Kick's cooldown)
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/rogue/RogueStrategy.cpp:373-391 (RogueCcStrategy: kick at ACTION_INTERRUPT + 1), :24 (kick -> kidney shot); ai/playerbot/strategy/rogue/RogueTriggers.h:9; ai/playerbot/strategy/rogue/RogueActions.h:111-115 (CastKickAction); ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:711-727 (rogues get 'cc'); ai/playerbot/strategy/generic/ThreatStrategy.cpp:60-73; ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:936-939 (InterruptSpellTrigger); ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAI.cpp:6541-6589 (IsInterruptableSpellCasting: a generic spell still on its cast bar or a channel)
rules.why_expect: every rogue has the cc strategy and the kick row outranks the whole combo rotation, so with no threat back-off this passes. But CastKickAction is a CastMeleeSpellAction (RogueActions.h:111-115) and inherits the ACTION_THREAT_SINGLE type (GenericSpellActions.h:39), and ThreatMultiplier scores every such action 0 while 'high threat' is active (ThreatStrategy.cpp:60-73). The rogue gets the threat strategy under a player tank (AiFactory.cpp:473-489,842-850) and its white swings keep it near 80 percent of a player tank with no gear, so Kick may be vetoed most of the fight. FAIL here with a PASS on the no-tank control would prove that

rules.desc: Precondition: Defensive Stance (aura 71) stays on the player through the fight, so the role read by the bot is the one this trial is about
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: the stance is read by ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:446-471 (GetPlayerRoles) unless the forced role decides first (ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAI.cpp:3986-3990)
rules.why_expect: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start; the runner's threat cast every 6 s keeps the player in the stance's rotation
